commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Sergi Altimira (Betis) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
87' Substitution. Pablo Fornals is replaced by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).

86' 2 - 0 Abde Ezzalzouli fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Vitor Roque (Betis) inside the box. He releases a quick shot into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:0.
85' A dangerous looking corner kick from Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) is cleared to safety by the defence.

77' The referee blows for a cooling break.

74' 1 - 0 Goal! Hector Bellerin produces a great pass that finds Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 1:0.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.

71' Natan (Betis) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
70' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
70' Hector Bellerin (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
66' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is substituted due to injury. Borja Jimenez gives a chance to Julian Chicco.
63' The shot by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Juan Soriano.
62' It is time for a substitution. Vitor Roque is on for Assane Diao (Betis).
62' Here's the change. Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) leaves the pitch and Hector Bellerin comes on as a substitute.
61' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) replacing Chimy Avila.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) comes onto the pitch so that Oscar Rodriguez can be given a rest.
61' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Enric Franquesa is replaced by Renato Tapia (Leganes).
60' Betis take a short corner kick.
59' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Juan Soriano comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' Betis are ruled offside.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
50' Romain Perraud (Betis) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

46' Half-time substitution. Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) is replaced by Matija Nastasic.
46' Borja Jimenez makes a half-time substitution. Adria Altimira comes on in place of Juan Cruz (Leganes).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Betis will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
45+3' 5:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
41' Adrian (Betis) gets a yellow card, off the field.

38' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Juan Soriano shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
37' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.
33' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
33' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
30' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Problems for Manuel Pellegrini as William Carvalho is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Sergi Altimira (Betis) replaces him.
24' Looks like William Carvalho (Betis) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
24' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
22' Sebastien Haller (Leganes) has a goal ruled out for offside!
21' A poor finish by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
16' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
12' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Juan Cruz (Leganes) for his blatant foul.
10' Juan Soriano (Leganes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
10' Juan Soriano (Leganes) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Betis fail to score from a corner as Juan Soriano (Leganes) leaps to collect the ball.
8' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
